verdict.headline: Cantinho da Baia Lunch
verdict.reason: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide helps a bit, but the bay still needs enough push.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY I’d go check the cams first—Cantinho da Baia at lunch is the best available option, but it sounds pretty marginal. Surfline looks poor-to-fair and the swell is small, so you’ll be relying on the sheltered bay to make it rideable, with low rising tide meaning the faster, shallower waves can get tricky. I’d look at Surfline and the MEO Beachcam for Cantinho before committing, and only leave if it’s cleaner than expected.

best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 179 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 68/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: 10-13s at low tide is fast and shallow in the sheltered bay; SwellMap rating 3/10 Poor — caution.
